summary: YMTC (Yangtze Memory Technologies Corp) Type: entity Tags: #semiconductor #memory #nand #china #ymtc ## Overview YMTC is China's leading NAND flash memory manufacturer, headquartered in Wuhan. It is a key player in China's memory chip self-sufficiency efforts. ## Key Facts - Founded: 2016 - Headquarters: Wuhan, China - Technology: Xtacking architecture for 3D NAND flash - Achievements: Reached 232-layer NAND, competitive with Samsung/Micron/SK Hynix - US Sanctions: Added to Entity List in December 2022, restricting equipment access ## Supply Chain Impact - Critical for China's memory chip independence - Xtacking technology is a differentiating architecture - Sanctions limit access to advanced deposition and etch equipment - Expanding mature node capacity for consumer electronics ## Related - [[china-semiconductor-localization]] - [[semiconductor-memory]] - [[nand-flash]]
